title: Power Rankings: Celtics the undisputed No. 1
heading: 2008-09 Power Rankings: Week 6
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Two things that absolutely, positively cannot be disputed this Monday: Boston is a unanimous No. 1, and the gap between the top three and everyone else is only growing after what the Celts did to Portland.

rankings.summaryHtml: We say there's more to life than victory margin, but those of you obsessed with it will note that L.A. is down to No. 2 there, too, after blown leads in Indy and D.C. gave the (underrated?) Cavs an opening.
